fd.description: File descriptor to signal readiness when proxies are set up. Null means no --fd flag is used.

proxies.description: List of proxy configurations, each specifying an address-path pair and filtering options.

proxies_items.description: Placeholder indicating proxies is a list of objects. Actual items are defined by the sub-fields below.

address.description: D-Bus address to proxy connections to (e.g. 'unix:path=/run/dbus/system_bus_socket' or 'unix:path=/run/user/1000/bus').

path.description: Unix domain socket path where the proxy will listen for client connections.

filter.description: Enable filtering mode for the proxy. If false, all messages are forwarded unfiltered.

log.description: Turn on logging for the proxy.

sloppy_names.description: Make all unique names visible regardless of policy.

see.description: List of well-known names for SEE policy (visible in introspection/listing).

talk.description: List of well-known names for TALK policy (can send/receive messages to/from these names).

own.description: List of well-known names for OWN policy (can request/release ownership).

call_rules_items.description: Placeholder for call_rules list of objects.

rule_name.description: Well-known name to which the call rule applies.

broadcast_rules_items.description: Placeholder for broadcast_rules list of objects.
